name: Responsive Hover Sidebar
useWhen: A project needs a dark collapsible sidebar where labels reveal on hover, focus, or explicit toggle, and active items are clear.
source: User-provided WhatsApp screenshot of a responsive sidebar clip with partial visible CSS.
implementationNotes: Labels must be available on hover, focus, and mobile, not hover-only.
Every nav target must be keyboard operable and have a visible active state.
On small screens, prefer the expanded readable state over icon-only navigation.
Use real route links or buttons wired to application state in production.
Keep source-video social UI and code frames out of previews.
reducedMotion: Remove width animation timing and reveal labels instantly while preserving focus order.
